description: The GTO range for one spot. `spot` is an action path of POSITION_ACTION pairs ending in the action whose range you want, e.g. NLHE cash "UTG_60%_HJ_Call", nlmtt8 "UTG_Open", or PLO "UTG_Open_HJ_3B". Add `hand` for one exact frequency and EV. Compact mode is default; PLO returns representative pure/mixed hands unless a hand is specified; plo5 returns the top hands by EV that take the action (limit up to 500 compact, 2000 full).

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

game.description: "nl" = no-limit hold'em 6-max cash (169-grid hands, per-hand EV in small blinds), "nl9" = no-limit hold'em 9-max cash, "nlmtt8" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV (10–300bb, 1bb BB-ante; Fold/Call/Limp/AI/Open/3B tokens), "nlh8-hydra" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT chip-EV with a classic 0.1bb ante from every seat (10, 20, 30, 60bb; same tokens as nlmtt8), "nlh8-icm" = no-limit hold'em 8-max MTT with ICM: one stack table per scenario (near the money, 33 or 35 left of 200, 30 paid; final table, 8 left), uneven stacks, 0.125bb ante from every seat, EVs in tournament dollars; pass scenario (list_games lists them; stack alone works only where one table has that depth); get_node only, "nlhu" = no-limit hold'em heads-up for the title, chip-EV, both players at the stack (1–40bb), 0.125bb ante each, SB on the button; get_node only, "plo" = pot-limit Omaha 6-max cash (4-card), "plo5" = pot-limit Omaha 5-card 6-max (100bb, 1.2bb ante), "plo9" = pot-limit Omaha 9-max cash, "plo6hu" = 6-card Omaha heads-up (BTN vs BB, 100bb). Cash trees are not tournament, ICM, PKO, or satellite solves. nlmtt8, nlh8-hydra and nlhu are chip-EV; only nlh8-icm is ICM.

limit.description: Maximum compact rows to return (default 120, maximum 500).

minFreq.description: Drop hands at or below this weight (PLO ranges are large)

spot.description: Action path ending in an action

stack.description: Stack depth in big blinds, e.g. 100

name: get_range

outputSchema.description: One action's range: hand-class frequencies, and EV where the bundle scored it.

action.description: plo5: the action the range belongs to.

actor.description: Position to act at this node.

columns.description: Column order for `range`: hand, frequency, evSb.

ev.description: Full detail: EV of the requested hand in small blinds.

evSb.description: EV of the requested hand in small blinds.

additionalProperties.description: EV in small blinds relative to folding.

evs.description: Hand class to EV, only where the solved bundle scored the hand.

freq.description: Full detail: frequency of the requested hand.

frequency.description: Frequency of the requested hand, 0 to 1.

hand.description: The requested hand, when one was asked for.

hint.description: How to narrow, page, or widen the same query.

history.description: Action path ending in the acting position.

items.description: One row: hand, frequency, EV in small blinds or null.

spot.description: Action path ending in an action, echoed from the request.

summary.description: What the compact range left out, so nothing looks complete when it is sampled.

classes.description: Postflop: hand classes with reach at the node.

matchingHands.description: plo5: classes that take the action before the cut.

mixedInReturned.description: plo5: mixed classes among the returned rows.

nonzeroHands.description: Hand classes with a frequency above 0.

omitted.description: Rows dropped by the compact cut.

pureInReturned.description: plo5: pure classes among the returned rows.

version.description: Dataset version where the bundle publishes one.

weights.description: Hand class to frequency. An omitted class has weight 0.
